---
title: Blog
description: >
  FIMS blog.
listing:
  contents:
    - "*.qmd"
    - "!fims-weekly-template.qmd"
  template: ../assets/blog.html
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  categories: true
  sort-ui: true
  filter-ui: true
  fields: [date, title, categories]
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false
comments: false
---

```{=html}
$for(categories)$
  <span class="articleCategory">$categories$</span>
$endfor$
```
